$comment: Contract-shape ratchet (scripts/ci/check_contract_shape.py, ADR-0081). Numbers may only fall; raising one requires --write-baseline --reason, recorded in growth_reasons.

growth_reasons.production_lines: Keep typed continuation provenance beside MessageId minting and existing steer/report classifiers; seven net production lines after consolidating duplicate Session-scoped identity formatting. No new contract dependency, port, protocol field, or stored authority. This slice adds the versioned caller toolset value beside Agent toolsets and the committed ResumeTicket, one pure fact shared by activation and recovery. Bind durable ToolResult MessageId to the existing ToolBatch Run and Step coordinate instead of response-local provider call IDs, and recognize canonical new IDs while reading legacy committed results; no new port, protocol field, or stored authority.
Exact provider and endpoint identity must cross the existing borrowed material resolver and serialized attempt delivery; the one-way binding fingerprint cannot authorize a live Vault read.

growth_reasons.catch_all_errors: merged awaken-environment-realization-contract; its 2 instances moved here, workspace total unchanged

growth_reasons.production_lines: SandboxEffectFence becomes the kernel EffectFence over the SandboxRealization tenure: one admission shared by new() and the flat-wire decoder (nonzero epoch, non-blank identity), typed accessors replacing public fields, and the FenceTamper fixture for provider decision tables (+42); validate_identity() callers are gone because the invariant is structural
growth_reasons.catch_all_errors: Classify/Disposition vocabulary moved down into agent-contract so sandbox failures classify without a provisioning->runtime edge; provisioning-contract gains the typed SandboxError classes and the neutral handle-evidence codec that replaced its backend payload enums (backend nouns 10->0); SandboxError Transport/Invalid are classified failure classes carrying detail, replacing the former untyped SandboxError(String)

growth_reasons.production_lines: MemoryGeneration coordinates become private: one whole-witness constructor and three accessors replace public fields so no caller edits one coordinate of an observed head (+18)
Canonical Epoch deserialization on four existing dispatch wire fields rejects unminted zero grants; no new types, dependencies or grant rules.
growth_reasons.depth: Removing the compatibility facade exposes direct domain-owner dependencies; retaining explicit state, realization, runtime, and ingress boundaries avoids a replacement aggregator.

growth_reasons.production_lines: RetryPolicy regains a count bound for rate limits (throttled_max_retries, default 12) alongside the logical deadline, so an instant zero-pause 429 stops at its count while a long pause stops at the deadline; a field, a default constant and doc lines. AttemptQuiescence is the existing backend-neutral live handle in RuntimeRunContext, shared by Native, ACP and A2A. Its 49-line closure extension reuses pinned Tokio TaskTracker and CancellationToken instead of a custom counter; putting the concrete handle in Runtime would create a contract-to-implementation cycle. No contract graph, backend vocabulary, persisted state or wire surface is added. This slice adds the sealed RunActivation source/format wire, live context projection, and a single checked parse used by constructors and serde; it closes a producer bypass found by rust-quick without IO or a second execution owner. Exact provider and endpoint identity must cross the existing borrowed material resolver and serialized attempt delivery; the one-way binding fingerprint cannot authorize a live Vault read.
